experiment: DeltaVision final held-out evaluation and statistical analysis

prior_test_exposure.statement: Synthetic held-out results were inspected in earlier benchmark experiments before this final evaluation; this is not a blind evaluation.

methods.name: approximate_patch_reuse_0.01
methods.selection_provenance: Fixed benchmark threshold grid; validation reports reviewed before final evaluation.

methods.name: global_change_fallback
methods.selection_provenance: Existing validation configuration and validation report.

handcrafted.timing_scope: All test frames are preloaded; includes RGB-statistics computation, patch comparisons, and cache updates. Excludes image and mask I/O, reference-feature generation, metric aggregation, and serialization.

pretrained_dinov2.cache_capacity_selection_provenance: Prespecified capacity used in the existing Task 15 validation evaluation; the Task 16 validation ablation was reviewed before this final evaluation.
pretrained_dinov2.timing_scope: Preloaded validation frames; includes preprocessing, exact input hashing and tensor equality checks, complete DINOv2 forwards on misses, and cache storage or retrieval. Excludes file I/O, model loading, feature audits, serialization, and plotting.

statistics.paired_comparisons: Use identical resampled episode indices for every method within a partition or DINOv2 condition.
